spans.s:
mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Who or what swallows.
m. (-लः)
1 The citron.
2 Swallowing.
E.
गॄ to swallow, affix क, and र changed to ल.

m. (-हः)
A shark.
E.
गिल, and ग्राह who seizes, who swallows.

mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्)
Swallowing, eating, devouring.
E.
गै to swallow, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
Swallowing; also गिरण.
E.
as before; र changed to ल.

Eating.
E.
see गिरि, र being changed to ल.

Swallowed.
E.
गॄ to swallow, affix क्त, गिरित, and र changed to ल.
